source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
title: NDRRMA rescue coordination portal
body: NDRRMA publishes rescue and coordination updates for the Bhotekoshi / Rasuwa flash flood on its official rescue portal and the SETU platform (setu.ndrrma.gov.np). Families should use these official channels for status — not unofficial social media reposts. This site links to NDRRMA; we do not copy individual case data.
